measures.title: Fresno County Hotel Tax
measures.summary: Placed on the ballot by the Board of Supervisors as a countywide vote, it would create a transient occupancy tax of 12% of the rent, paid only by guests staying 30 days or less in hotels, motels, short-term rentals or other lodging in the unincorporated area of Fresno County. County Counsel estimates about $4.55 million a year in general revenue, starting January 1, 2027 and lasting until changed or repealed by voters, usable for any County purpose. It requires a majority vote.
measures.yesMeans: The County adopts a 12% tax on short-term lodging stays in the unincorporated area.
measures.noMeans: No County transient occupancy tax is adopted.

measures.title: Fresno County Transportation Improvement Act
measures.summary: A citizen initiative that would impose a half-cent (0.5%) countywide sales tax for 30 years starting July 1, 2027, when the existing Measure C transportation tax expires. Proceeds would go to the Fresno Council of Governments, which would allocate 65% to local streets and roads, 25% to public transit, 1% to Fresno Yosemite International Airport, 4% to regional street and highway projects, 4% to zero-fare transit and clean transportation grants, and 1% to administration, with a citizens oversight committee and annual audits.
measures.yesMeans: A half-cent sales tax for transportation is imposed countywide for 30 years beginning July 1, 2027.
measures.noMeans: The half-cent transportation sales tax is not imposed, and the Measure C tax ends when it expires.

measures.title: Fresno Public Safety, Infrastructure Restoration, and City General Services Tax Measure
measures.summary: Asks City of Fresno voters to approve a one-half percent (0.5%) general sales and use tax on retail sales in the city, starting July 1, 2027. The City estimates about $65,000,000 a year, usable for any City purpose, with public disclosure, independent audits and citizen oversight. The tax ends after 10 years, or earlier if the County adopts a transportation sales tax of equal or greater rate that benefits the City.
measures.yesMeans: The City of Fresno adds a 0.5% general sales tax beginning July 1, 2027.
measures.noMeans: The City of Fresno does not add the 0.5% sales tax.
